terms.comment: Lewis & Short gives only “snow” (Lucretius, Apuleius); Traupman uses it for a snowdrift.

phrases.latin: Tata, spectā! Nix est! Omnia nive tēcta sunt!
phrases.english: Dad, look! It’s snow! Everything is covered in snow!
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: Lewis & Short: nix
